name: mediastore-data
description: An AWS Elemental MediaStore asset is an object, similar to an object in the Amazon S3 service.

subcommands.name: delete-object
subcommands.description: Deletes an object at the specified path.

subcommands.name: describe-object
subcommands.description: Gets the headers for an object at the specified path.

subcommands.name: get-object
subcommands.description: Downloads the object at the specified path.

subcommands.name: list-items
subcommands.description: Provides a list of metadata entries about folders and objects in the specified folder.

subcommands.name: put-object
subcommands.description: Uploads an object to the specified path.
